newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Prisoner shot dead in jailbreak bid in Albania.
newsitem.headline: Prisoner shot dead in jailbreak bid in Albania.

text.p: Guards shot dead a prisoner and wounded three others on Sunday during an attempted breakout from a jail in northwest Albania, the Justice Ministry said.
A ministry spokesman said the prisoners had taken the governor of Lezhe jail and another senior prison official hostage and tried to use them as human shields to flee.
The spokesman said the escaping prisoners got as far as the perimeter of the jail with their two hostages.

"The guards, in accordance with and respect for the law, opened fire on those trying to flee. As a result, one prisoner was killed and three others were injured," the spokesman said in a statement. Both hostages were safe.
The spokesman said the breakout attempt happened after news reached the jail of a mass escape by inmates from a prison in the southern Adriatic town of Sarande.

Sarande jail was stormed by armed rioters who took control of the town on Sunday in the mounting unrest that has rocked Albania since the collapse almost two months ago of risky investment schemes in which Albanians lost their life savings.
